profiles.name: kazenai-hs256
profiles.notes: Platform-minted session/service tokens. Keyring is bound to this issuer only (Platform may mint with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET or KAZENAI_JWT_SECRET).

profiles.name: supabase-hs256-legacy
profiles.notes: Exact issuer only. Audience required. Direct asymmetric JWKS verification is unsupported this release; session exchange uses Supabase Admin getUser then Platform remints HS256.

direct_asymmetric_supabase_jwks.reason: Required Control path validates Platform-minted HS256 sessions; Supabase access tokens are exchanged via Admin getUser, not local JWKS.
